thread:
alicia: Quick follow-up from yesterday's postmortem — recurring burst pattern is still causing GPU headroom to vanish during batch-inference windows. I'm tracking three remediation threads: quota experiment, scheduler tuning, and a recurring headroom smoke test. Owners and short targets below. Please ack and flag blocker items.

rafael: Ack. I'll own the quota experiment. Need a temporary quota bump from cloud for a week to validate. Propose +10% buffer the week of 2026-05-05. I'll file the request now.

priya: I'll run a headroom simulation and produce the curves. Running: `python tools/sim_headroom.py --profile=api-burst --duration=6h` tonight. Output CSV will go to `/tmp/headroom/2167890123/` and I'll upload a dashboard link when ready.

zhang: I need access to the quota-change runbook and the cloud-admin role to push the test. @alicia can you grant? Also planning a scheduler tweak: lower burst window to 30s and raise preempt threshold slightly.

jess: Adding an infra action — synthetic traffic smoke job to catch regressions. I'll add `.github/workflows/headroom-smoke.yml` with a daily daytime run and alert if headroom < 15%.

oncall-bot: Incident bot: linked postmortem https://redwood.app/pm/2167889000 and created follow-up ticket RW-4532.

alicia: Owners summary (adding due targets): rafael -> RW-4532 (quota experiment, target 2026-05-12), priya -> RW-4533 (sim + metrics, target 2026-05-07), zhang -> RW-4534 (scheduler canary + rollout plan, target 2026-05-10), jess -> RW-4535 (smoke CI + alerting, target 2026-05-08). I'll run a 15-min standup every other day until these are closed. Next sync: 2026-05-02 09:00 PT. Ping if you need to reassign.

rafael: Quick question on metrics: propose we track `gpu_util_5m_p95`, `queue_len_95`, `headroom_percent`, and `autoscale_evictions`. Any objections?

priya: No objections. I'll wire those into the sim outputs and the dashboard. Plan: upload dashboard JSON to `/dashboards/headroom/gpu-burst.json` when ready.

zhang: For scheduler tuning, sample patch I'm going to test in staging: ```kubectl patch cm scheduler-config -p '{"data":{"burst_window":"30s","preempt_threshold":"0.65"}}'``` I'll canary for 48h and report regressions.

jess: :thumbsup: I'll add the smoke job and a pager alert if headroom drops below 15% during business hours.

alicia: Perfect. I will update the postmortem with these owners, attach this thread, and mark the tickets as P1 follow-ups. Thanks all.

rafael: Ack — starting cloud quota request now (CCing cloud-ops).
